description: Second floor level front extension; ground and first floor level side/rear 'infill extension'; ground floor level 'infill' side extension (formerly a courtyard); alteration/reshaping of side building line to the east elevation; raising the height of the flat roof/parapet to the first and ground floor level rear building components, associated with the use of rear roofs for external amenity areas and installation of balustrading and safety rails; installation of sted accesses to rear ground floor; alteration/insertion/enlargement of window and door openings; and external alterations (As an amendment to planning permission ref: P/2002/2782-LB dated16/01/03 for 'Demolition of existing industrial unit and erection of a 3 storey block, consisting of 1 three bedroom flat and 5 two bedroom flats with basement parking for seven cars
